changes.title: Trump Sought an Iran War Exit. Putin Pushed On in Ukraine. Now Both Are Stuck.
changes.summary: The Iran and Ukraine wars underline the common limits of military force in achieving political ends, but also the differences between a dug-in Russian president and a vacillating American one.

changes.title: Graham makes final remarks in Ukraine a day before this death
changes.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and made public remarks during a trip to Kyiv just one day before his death. Graham said he was focused on advancing legislation aimed at imposing sanctions on Russian oil.

changes.title: Zelensky Announces Leadership Shuffle as War Turns in Ukraine’s Favor
changes.summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine’s prime minister, Yuliia Svyrydenko, would step down amid a broader shake-up in Ukraine’s senior leadership.
